`test_zip_archive_extract_to_matches_php` asserted that
`extractTo("/no/such/root/x")` answers `false`, which is true on a developer
machine and on CI's macOS shards. The linux shards run inside a container as
root, where `mkdir -p /no/such/root/x` SUCCEEDS — so the case flipped to `true`
and both linux shards failed while macOS stayed green: run 31955378116, shards
`linux-aarch64 14/16` and `linux-x86_64 14/16`, one assertion, exactly the
fourth value.

The destination is now a path THROUGH A FILE
